title: 49ers P Corliss Waitman is the NFC special teams player of the week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers P Corliss Waitman is the NFC special teams player of the week
sources.description: The 49ers picked up a big win over a divisional rival by beating the Seahawks 32-29 last weekend and punter Corliss Waitman helped get them that victory.
